entry.content:
What do you do when you can't do what you do?

2025-09-02

Nine months. 179 applications. Four interviews.

Zero jobs.

After 26 years as a web developer, it seems like the global consensus is that I'm not qualified to be a web developer anymore.

And that's terrifying.

So... what do you do when the world is telling you that you can't do the only thing you know how to do anymore??
